Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India

Dr. Arun Mohan Sherry

Director, IIIT-Lucknow

Dr. Arun Mohan Sherry is an M.Sc. (Gold Medalist), M.Tech. (Computer Science -IIT Kharagpur), Ph.D. He is a recipient of Anand Swarup Bhatnagar Gold Medal for securing highest marks in post-graduate examination; Brilliant Student Honor by Lions Club; “Indian Icon Award” for outstanding accomplishments and excellence in the field of Education-2010 and “Rabindranath Tagore Samman”-2011 for his contribution in the field of Technical Education.

Dr. Sherry obtained expertise in the latest trend in Technology and Management, by various specialized programmes of IIMs and IITs. He has over 25 years’ professional experience in the areas of academics, research, consulting, administration and ‘institution building’. He has supervised many candidates for Ph.D Degrees and more than 100 postgraduate projects. He has published over 40 papers in international/ national journals and conferences. His Articles & Interviews have been published by National News Papers like “Times of India”, “Economic Times”, “Hindustan Times”, etc. and Electronic Media. He has Chaired/Co-chaired many International Conferences. He is also editor of reputed International/National Journals. Apart from teaching and research, he   has also served in several senior level leadership positions such as Chairman (Research), Chairman (Students Affairs), Dean (Academics) , Chairman (Admissions) of IMT Ghaziabad, Director of IMT-CDL, Ghaziabad. He is also involved in consultancy to various Public Sector Units. Visited several countries including France, Austria, Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai, Taiwan etc. for academic assignments.

He visited South Korea, Austria, Switzerland and Mongolia as a member of delegation accompanying H.E. Mrs. Pratibha Devisingh Patil, President of India.

He has also served as the CAO of a joint venture of HT Media Ltd. And Apollo Global Inc.(USA), Senior Vice-President/Dean & Head of Academics of HCL Talentcare and CAO of NMIMS, Mumbai.

Presently he is the Director of Indian Institute of Information Technology, Lucknow-India.

He is Governing Council Member of Inter-University Accelerator Center (IUAC) New Delhi, Member of National Institutional Ranking Framework(NIRF) society, Visiting Chairman of NBA team, Governing Body Member of IIT Kanpur “Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Driven Entrepreneurship (AIIDE)” Center. He is also the member of Academic Council of Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur.

Dr. Deepak Kumar Singh

Dr. Deepak Kumar Singh

Ph.D (IIT Kanpur)

Dr. Deepak Kumar Singh

Associate Professor

Research Interests

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Internet of Things
  • Data Security and Privacy
  • Cloud Computing

Latest Achievements

  • In the advisory board of UPTEC (an UP Govt funded company).
  • Ex-consultant UP Govt.

Education

  • Ph.D.(Neural Networks) from Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur
  • M.Tech (IT) from Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad

Teaching

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Data Analytics
  • Python
  • Cloud Computing

Projects

  • Audio based condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of internal combustion engines. (Project funded by TIFAC, Government of India), Completed on August 2007.
  • Separation of Audio and Image mixtures using neural networks. (Project funded by Department of Information Technology, Government of India). Completed on December 2009.
  • Modernization of Public Libraries of UP Government. A government funded project.
  • Implementation of Learning management Solution for Jaipuria Institute of Management, Lucknow.
  • Implementation of learning Management Solution in BBD Group of Institution, Lucknow.

Publications

Supervised Thesis / Ph. D. Dissertations
  • Mr. Avinash Verma, “Reading framework for Visually challenged,” Ph. D., awarded on 15th July 2019. (BBD University Lucknow)

Publications

Post Graduate Thesis Supervision
  • Supervised more than 10 M Tech. (CS/IT) students

Publications

Selected Publications in International Journals
  • “Parameters of automated fraud detection techniques during online transactions” published in " Journal of Financial Crime”. Co-authored by Vipin Khattri.
  • “Automatic Detection of Tree Cutting in Forests using Acoustic Properties “published in “Journal of King Saud University -Computer and Information Sciences”. Co-authored by Mr Sheikh Fahad Ahmad.
  • 'Implementation of Additional Factor for Secure Authentication,' in the Journal of Organizational Computing and Electronic Commerce published by Taylor and Francis ( ISSN: 1091-9392 )co-authored by Mr Vipin Khattri.
  • “Brain Tumor Detection in FMRI Images” published in International Journal of Innovative Technology and Exploring Engineering (IJITEE). co-authored by Roshan Jahan, and Pritam Suman.
  • “An Enhanced Authentication Technique to Mitigate the Online Transaction Fraud” in Book Intelligent Communication, Control and Devices as book chapter. The book is published by Springer and is indexed in SCOPUS under AISC series.
  • “Development of Integrated Distance Authentication and Fingerprint Authorization Mechanism to Reduce Fraudulent Online Transaction” publication in Book Intelligent Communication, Control and Devices as book chapter. The book is published by Springer and is indexed in SCOPUS under AISC series.
  • “Load Forecasting Using New Error Measures in Neural Networks”. Deepak Kumar Singh, Md. Shiblee, International Journal of Scientific & Engineering Research Volume 2, Issue 5, May-2011
  • Brain Signal Analysis: A Statistical Approach”, Deepak Mishra, Deepak Kumar Singh, Prem K. Kalra, Indian Journal of Computational Neuroscience -2006.

Dr. Neelu

Assistant Professor, IIITL

About

  • Dr. Neelu is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Management and Humanities at IIIT Lucknow. She has previously worked with Johns Hopkins University, Washington D.C., Jawaharlal Nehru University New Delhi, and Guru Nanak Dev University Amritsar. She has earned her Doctorate in Linguistics from JNU, New Delhi for the thesis titled 'Determining Feature Robustness and Feature Hierarchy with focus on Voice Features in Speaker Identification.' Her primary teaching interest areas include Communications and Applied Linguistics. She speaks Hindi, English and Spanish (intermediate).

Research Interests:

  • Public Speaking Anxiety
  • English Language Teaching
  • Forensic Linguistics
  • Acoustics and Experimental Phonetics

Teaching Interests:

  • Professional Communication
  • Technical Writing
  • Business Communication
  • Applied Linguistics

  • Associated with Pearson India (2013 -2014)
  • Guest Lecturer, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi (August 2012-July 2013)

Research Interests

  • Homogenization theory
  • Elliptic Partial Differential Equations
  • Optimal controls
  • Almost periodic solutions

Member of Professional Society

  • Member of American Mathematical Society (AMS), 2019-2020.

Review Committee Member

  • Reviewer of Mathscinet, American Mathematical Society (AMS).

Postdoc Experiences

  • Women Scientist-A, Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Bhopal, India (2018-2020).
  • Postdoctoral Fellow, Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Bhopal, India (2015-2017).
  • Visiting Researcher, University of Chile, Santiago, Chile (2014-2015).
  • Postdoctoral Fellow, The Institute of Mathematical Sciences, Chennai, India (2013-2014)

Education

  • Ph. D. (Partial Differential Equations), Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur; 2013.
  • M. Sc. (Mathematics), University of Lucknow (2004-2006).
  • B. Sc., University of Lucknow (2001-2004).

Awards/Recognitions

  • Women Scientist-A 2018, Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India.
  • GATE (Mathematics), 2009; CSIR-UGC JRF, 2009; NBHM Ph. D. Fellowship, 2007, CSIR-UGC NET (LS), 2006.

Course Taught

  • Partial Differential Equations, Aug-Nov 2017, IISER Bhopal.

Research Publications

(International Journals)
  • I. Mishra, Almost automorphy and Riccati equation, Differ. Equ. Dyn. Syst. 27 (2019) pp. 379-394.
  • I. Mishra, M. Sharma, Approximate controllability of a non-autonomous differential equation, Proc. Indian Acad. Sci. Math. Sci. 128 (2018), pp. 1-13.
  • N. Agarwal, C. Conca, I. Mishra, Approximate controllability of a semilinear elliptic problem with Robin condition in a periodically perforated domain, Electron. J. Differential Equations 2017 (2017), No. 186, pp. 1-24.
  • C. Conca, P. Donato, E. C. Jose, I. Mishra, Asymptotic analysis of optimal controls of a semilinear elliptic problem in a perforated domain, J. Ramanujan Math. Soc. 31, No. 3 (2016), pp. 265-305.
  • I. Mishra, D. Bahuguna, Weighted pseudo almost automorphic solution of an integro-differential equation, with weighted stepanov-like pseudo almost au- tomorphic forcing term, Appl. Math. Comput. 219 (2013), pp. 5345-5355.
  • I. Mishra, D. Bahuguna, Almost automorphic mild solutions of hyperbolic evolution equations with stepanov-like almost automorphic forcing term, Electron. J. Differential Equations 2012 (2012), pp. 1-11.
  • I. Mishra, D. Bahuguna, Weighted pseudo almost automorphic solution of an integro-differential equation with weighted stepanov-like almost automorphic forcing term, Electron. J. Differential Equations 2012 (2012), pp. 1-11.
  • I. Mishra, D. Bahuguna, Existence of almost automorphic solutions of neutral differential equations, J. Nonlinear Evol. Equ. Appl. 2012 (2012), pp. 17-28.
  • I. Mishra, C-semigroups and almost periodic solution of non-autonomous evolution equations, Int. J. Evol. Equ. 6 (2011), pp. 265-278.

Career Summary

Dr. Srinivas Padmanabhuni was awarded the title of “Eminent Engineer” by the prestigious and renowned organization “Institution of Engineers” (IEI). The award was given 2 Dr. Srinivas Padmanabhuni in recognition of his experience and contributions to the profession of Computers at the 32nd Annual convention of IEI His vast experience in the computing field, including marquee area of Artificial Intelligence (AI), brings a unique blend of academic, research and industry orientation, a rare combination. Srinivas Padmanabhuni is a Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence. Srinivas Padmanabhuni co-founded CityMandi.com a next generation AI enabled smart B2B startup in Agri Tech focused on farm to fork. He has been the past president of ACM India, the top professional organization of computing professionals. He is the chief Mentor for Tarah technologies an AI consulting and training company. He specializes in areas of software engineering, AI and Machine Learning. Earlier, he was a Principal Research Scientist and Associate Vice President at Infosys where he overlooked the university innovation ecosystem, alongside research and innovation group in Infosys Labs. He has won several other awards including the excellence award for Innovation at Infosys, Research excellence award at University of Alberta, and Merit award at IIT Kanpur, He is a Ph.D in AI from University of Alberta, Edmonton, Canada, specializing in AI. Prior to Ph.D. he secured his B.Tech from IIT Kanpur and M.Tech in CS from IIT Bombay. His interests: AI, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity.

He has to his credit: Seven granted patents Multiple additional patents in process One published book by Wiley100+ refereed international publications400+ invited talks across eight countries15000 + students lectured on AI, and related topics 4 + startups

  • Overall ownership for strategic management process including formulation, implementation and review by working collaboratively with the leadership team and Board of Directors

  • Conceptualizing and incubating new revenue lines in research, business intelligence and analytics

  • Conducting onsite BD trips and leading competitive bids across the RFP-due diligence-pilot lifecycle
  • Progressing from project manager to Director and Head of Research Operations within four years

[email protected]
Lucknow

Dr. Sheshadri Chatterjee

Visiting Faculty

Profile

Sheshadri is having around 14 years of work experience in various global organizations such as IBM Global Business Services, Hewlett Packard Company, Royal Dutch Shell, and Microsoft Corporation. Currently he is working at Microsoft Corporation as Asia Pacific Regional Solution lead. Sheshadri is the expert and practitioner in the areas of Customer Relationship Management (MS-Dynamics Platform), Cloud Computing (Azure), IT Consulting (ERP-SAP), IT Project Management (PMI Framework), Business Analytics & Visualization (Power BI), IT Strategy & Change Management (Pro Sci framework ), IT Service Management (ITIL & TOGAF), Technology Adoption, Security & Privacy issues (Cybersecurity), Cyberlaw and Smart City Concepts. Sheshadri has visited several countries for professional purposes and for conducting corporate trainings and workshops.

Education

  • Ph.D (IIT Delhi)
  • MBA (IIT Delhi)

Experience

  • IIT Delhi (Guest Faculty) : Undertaken few selective course modules in Management department.
  • IIM Amritsar, Jammu, Kashipur (Visiting Faculty): Undertaken courses such as: Big data & Analytics, MIS.
  • IIIT Raipur (Adjunct Faculty): Subjects - Digital Marketing.
  • BITS Pilani, NIIT University (Guest Faculty): Course taken Data Mining, Business Analytics, CRM etc.

Industry Experience

  • IBM Global Business Services (Consulting division). He worked as SAP Solution Consultant, Project Manager & Learning & Development Manager. 2006-2011.
  • Royal Dutch Shell: Worked as partner from IBM with onsite SAP consulting. 2008-2010.
  • Hewlett Packard Company: Worked at Enterprise Services Division as Business Planning and Operational Excellence Lead and as a Program Manager. 2011-2012.
  • Microsoft Corporation: Joined Microsoft as Regional Solution Manager for Asia Pacific Region. Worked in 17 countries across Asia Pacific region. Involved in adoption and capability management with Dynamics platform (CRM, AX), AZURE Platform, Analytics Platform (Power BI) and Change Management (Pro-Sci). 2012-2020.

Research Experience

International Journal Publications (Partial list)
  • Chatterjee, S., & Kar, A.K. (2020). Why do small and medium enterprises use social media marketing and what is the impact: Empirical insights from India. International Journal of Information Management (Elsevier, ABDC: A*, Impact Factor 8.2)
  • Chatterjee, S. (2019). Internet of Things and social platforms: an empirical analysis from Indian consumer behavioral perspective. Journal of Behavior & Information Technology. (Taylor & Francis, ABDC: A, Impact Factor 1.8)
  • Chatterjee, S., Kar, A.K., & Mustafa, S.Z. (2019). Securing IoT devices in smart cities of India: from ethical and enterprise information system management perspective. Enterprise Information Systems. (Taylor & Francis, ABDC: A, Impact Factor 2.14)
  • Chatterjee, S. & Kar, A.K. (2018). Success of IoT in Smart Cities of India: An empirical analysis. R&R in Government Information Quarterly. (Elsevier, ABS 3*, Impact Factor 5.1)

About

Dr. Kumar Krishen is the Chief Technologist for the Krishen Foundation, responsible for developing strategies for joint research and technology projects and plans with organizations involved in developing technology to enable and fuel the betterment of life for humanity. Dr. Krishen was with NASA as ST/ Senior Scientist and Lead Technologist and served for more than forty two years and is the recipient of the NASA Exceptional Service Medal. 

Dr. Krishen has served Virginia Tech as University Fellow for Technology Transfer, Office of Special Initiatives, and Visiting Professor on a special NASA assignment. He also served as Adjunct Professor at Rice University. Currently, Dr. Krishen holds the appointment of Adjunct Professor at the University of Houston, USA and Honorary Professor for Delhi Technological University in India.

Dr. Dayanand Pandey

Dr. Dayanand Pandey

Visiting Faculty

Dr. Dayanand Pandey is a senior Academic professional with more than 30 years
of rich and varied experience in Academic leadership, Corporate Training,
Consulting, Teaching & Research. Currently he is Professor & Dean at O P Jindal
Global University, Sonipat.
Prior to joining O P Jindal Global University, he served as Professor and Director at
Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida; Professor and Director, School of
Business, UPES Dehradun; head of Centre of Innovation & Excellence at
Middlesex University Dubai; Dean Undergraduate programs at IMT, Dubai,
Professor & Dean of Jindal Global Business School NCR Delhi; head of Finance &
Banking program at the British University in Dubai (BUiD) for University of
Birmingham; Regional Head of Risk Management &Training at Bank Melli Iran
(BMI), Dubai; Coordinator of Master of Applied Finance and Banking Program
with the University of Wollongong in Dubai; Senior Lecturer at the Emirates
Institute for Banking and Financial Studies in Sharjah; Professor of Economics
and Chairman Global MBA program at IMT, Ghaziabad, Senior Assistant Professor
at Birla Institute of Management Technology (BIMTECH) at Delhi and Lecturer in
Delhi University
He is a Graduate in Economics with Gold medal from St. Xavier’s College, Ranchi
(1989); Postgraduate in Business Economics (1991) from University of Delhi, Ph. D
in Enterprise Risk Management (2002) from B R Ambedkar University, Agra and
UGC NET in Economics in 1994. He has earned certificate courses on Portfolio
Risk Management from Swiss Finance Institute Geneva, Credit Risk Management
and Enterprise Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals,
London.
Dr. Pandey has to his credit a book on ‘Managerial Economics’ from Pearson
education, ‘Economic Environment of India’ and ‘Risk Management’ from Excel
Publication, Delhi. He is a regular speaker in various media channels, Global
Association of Risk Professionals (GARP), Professional Risk Management
International Association (PRMIA), Incisive Media, Marcus Evans, Fleming Gulf,
CRO Enclave and various Industry and Academic forums in India, and abroad.

The PLP in Drafting Legislation, Regulation, and Policy has been offered by the Institute of Advanced Legal Studies with considerable success since 2004.

ApplyDownload Brochure

The programme aims to promote an understanding of the principles of legislative and an awareness of what constitutes legislative quality, how this can be achieved.

Legislative drafting is often perceived as a skill that one learns on the job.
Legislative drafting has evolved to become the bedrock of political, economic and social transformation. The view of the Institute’s Sir William Doe Centre for Legislative Studies is that legislative drafting is a practical discipline requiring awareness of the principles of drafting along with great experience on the job. It is still, however, relatively unexplored as a discipline. The PLP examines issues related to the policy process, the legislative process and the drafting process.

The PLP is aimed at those seeking a career in legislative drafting, those already working as drafters or those who want a career in or already working for, organizations that produce different types of normative acts. Many of our students are mid-career drafters employed by government (for example, by LG Chambers, the Ministry of Justice or any other ministries).

Introduction to Financial Accounting

Course ID
ACC101
Campus
KU2 Hill
Level
Undergraduate
Semester
Fall 2018
Credit
4.000
Method
Lecture

If you’re an educational professional who are looking to progress into management and consultancy, or an educational planning or development role, this is the best degree for you.

Provided by the KU Institute of Education, this programme is available by distance learning, allowing you to study flexibly while balancing work and personal lifes.

The MSc Finance (EG. Banking) deepens your understanding of banks and financial markets, and how they relate to performance. It will help you to advance your career in finance and policy.

  • Banking
  • Economic Policy
  • Financial Sector Management
  • Quantitative Finance
TimePlaceRoomDate RangeInstructor
9:00am – 11:00amKU2 Hill203Aug 21, 2018 – Dec 15, 2018Carol Dawson (PhD)

The PLP in Drafting Legislation, Regulation, and Policy has been offered by the Institute of Advanced Legal Studies with considerable success since 2004.

ApplyDownload Brochure

The programme aims to promote an understanding of the principles of legislative and an awareness of what constitutes legislative quality, how this can be achieved.

Legislative drafting is often perceived as a skill that one learns on the job.
Legislative drafting has evolved to become the bedrock of political, economic and social transformation. The view of the Institute’s Sir William Doe Centre for Legislative Studies is that legislative drafting is a practical discipline requiring awareness of the principles of drafting along with great experience on the job. It is still, however, relatively unexplored as a discipline. The PLP examines issues related to the policy process, the legislative process and the drafting process.

The PLP is aimed at those seeking a career in legislative drafting, those already working as drafters or those who want a career in or already working for, organizations that produce different types of normative acts. Many of our students are mid-career drafters employed by government (for example, by LG Chambers, the Ministry of Justice or any other ministries).
